newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cyprus Amax looks to expand in Australia coal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cyprus Amax looks to expand in Australia coal.

text.p: Cyprus-Amax Minerals Coal (USA), the second-largest coal producer in the United States, is looking to expand its operations further in Australia, a senior official told Reuters on Monday.

Vince Calarco, vice president business development of the coal arm of U.S. mining giant Cyprus Amax Minerals Co, said Cyprus-Amax was looking to "diversify its basket" of coal operations outside the United States.

Amax owns a 41.3 percent interest in Australia's formerly-listed Oakbridge Ltd and a 50 percent stake in the Springvale mine, near Lithgow, New South Wales, in partnership with Samsung (Australia) Pty Ltd, part of Korea's Samsung group.
Calarco also said the company was looking to expand its coal operations into Indonesia.
Cyprus-Amax produces about 80 million short tonnes of coal a year, he said.
